user_question: ce que tu appelles "redéploiement" c'est quand on "tue" un drone nous meme ? et qu'on le fait revenir via la compétence ?
clarification: Recall keeps the same living drone and its current HP/energy, equipment and Mule cargo. Redeployment uses its invocation skill to return this preserved drone to the map at accepted skill cost/cooldown. Destruction followed by legal invocation creates a new full-reserve drone, while old real items remain ground.
